gloss: rowing by hand; oar-powered; manually rowed/paddled

definitions.gloss: rowing by hand; powered by hand-operated oars (as opposed to a motor)
definitions.explanation: Used as a noun and as a noun-modifier (with の) to describe boats, vehicles, or simple machines that are propelled by human muscle power — typically by oars or paddles — rather than by an engine or motor. Most often heard in {手漕|てこ}ぎボート ("rowboat").

examples.japanese: {手漕|てこ}ぎボートに{乗|の}る。
{湖|みずうみ}で{手漕|てこ}ぎボートを{借|か}りた。
examples.english: We rented a rowboat at the lake.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{昔|むかし}、{手漕|てこ}ぎの{舟|ふね}で{毎日|まいにち}{漁|りょう}に{出|で}ていた。
examples.english: My grandfather used to go out fishing every day in a hand-rowed boat.

examples.japanese: モーターボートと{違|ちが}って、{手漕|てこ}ぎボートは{静|しず}かに{湖面|こめん}を{進|すす}むので{自然|しぜん}を{楽|たの}しめる。
examples.english: Unlike motorboats, rowboats glide quietly across the lake's surface, so you can really enjoy nature.

notes:
{手漕|てこ}ぎ is the noun form of {手|て}{漕|こ}ぐ (literally "to row by hand"), used to describe vehicles or boats propelled by human-powered oars or paddles. It is overwhelmingly used as a modifier of another noun (especially {手漕|てこ}ぎボート), with の as the connector.

FORMS:
- {手|て} ("hand") + {漕|こ}ぎ (the noun form of {漕|こ}ぐ "to row, to paddle")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手漕|てこ}ぎボート: rowboat (the most frequent use)
- {手漕|てこ}ぎの{船|ふね} / {手漕|てこ}ぎの{舟|ふね}: a hand-rowed boat
- {手漕|てこ}ぎポンプ: hand-operated pump
- {手漕|てこ}ぎで{進|すす}む: to advance by rowing (by hand)

SIMILAR / CONTRASTING TERMS:
- {足漕|あしこ}ぎ: pedal-powered (e.g. {足漕|あしこ}ぎボート "pedal boat")
- {電動|でんどう}: electric-powered (the modern contrast)
- モーター{付|つ}き: motor-equipped
- {自動|じどう}: automatic / self-propelled

USAGE:
- Although {手漕|てこ}ぎ technically can describe other hand-cranked devices (e.g. an old hand pump), in everyday Japanese it almost always refers to boats. Outside that context, native speakers more often spell out {手|て}{動|どう} ("manual") or {手|て}で{漕|こ}ぐ as a verb phrase.
- When attached to another noun, the connector is の: {手漕|てこ}ぎの{船|ふね}, not {手漕|てこ}ぎ{船|ぶね}.
